title.pt-BR: [M1] Leitura + laboratório: Fundamentos de sistemas distribuídos

description.en:
Module 1: Distributed systems fundamentals.
Start with 10 min of flashcards.

Reading (2 h):
- DDIA ch. 8, first half: partial failures, unreliable networks, timeouts. Write down the 3 possible outcomes of a timeout (happened, didn't happen, unknown).
- DDIA ch. 8, second half: unreliable clocks, process pauses, truth defined by the majority. Write down why you can't order events by wall clock and what a Lamport clock is.

Lab (1 h):
Create the public repo (services/, docs/, chaos/) with the NestJS skeleton and Docker Compose with a Postgres primary + async replica (streaming replication).
In labs, use AI only to clarify concepts, never to write TCM code.
